verdict.rationale: Bugbot is an AI code-review service, so outbound event webhooks (e.g., review completed, issue found) are a fair capability to ask about, and the axis applies. The evidence only shows Bugbot reacting to inbound PR events through the GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket integrations and posting PR comments. Nothing documents a way for users to subscribe to Bugbot events via webhooks; Bugbot Automations covers org-wide rules, not event delivery.
